about: Cut lines for the ID card's photograph in depth (spec v3 §3.2). Points are pixels of the card's square crop at 960 px (tools/photos/live.mjs: eren-ytu-gate.jpg, 1150 px from (680, 290)), drawn once over the photograph at 2x and smoothed at build time. person: head, hair, hood, shoulders and straps. near: the thumbs-up hand and its forearm.
